audit_type: Read-only inventory and provenance verification; no recalibration, optical test or hardware access.
scope: Lens Brown k1/k2/p1/p2 calibration and controlled rotation/tilt work; automatic chessboard tracking is deferred. This record does not qualify deployment.

video_metadata_as_recorded.coordinate_policy: Native H.264 decoded raster, x right / y down; no scaling, cropping or perspective correction before fitting.

target_as_recorded.square_source: User measured five squares = 95mm; equality of horizontal and vertical print scale is unconfirmed.
target_as_recorded.mounting_evidence: Confirmed by user during the preceding capture on 2026-10-22.

limitations_as_recorded: Held-out residual and line straightness improve modestly; they do not establish absolute physical correction accuracy.
Time-block estimates disagree in source maps, including in their common observed source region; constant full-frame parameters are not independently validated.
Whole-area AF describes an AF area and does not establish movie-servo state or a locked focus position.
Different time blocks have different poses, coverage, sample counts and residuals; map disagreement cannot be attributed to AF from these data.
Image corners are less constrained than the center; the lower-right image corner has the weakest direct corner observations.
Validation views share a recording session and use their own corners for pose estimation; this is not an independent acquisition or known-ground-truth accuracy test.
OBS applies no spatial transform in this recording; internal camera/capture-card processing is not established by that fact.
No MTF50/SFR, hardware timing or FPGA resource measurements were performed in this calibration step.

next_camera_collection.item: 固定并记录相机成像状态
next_camera_collection.details: 保持18mm及原生1920×1080 HDMI模式，锁定对焦；记录视频伺服AF、机内镜头校正、防抖、曝光、采集卡/OBS尺寸与是否缩放。旧记录中的未确认项不能推定为已关闭。
平整硬板上的完整9×6内角点棋盘，覆盖画面中心、边缘、四角及多种距离和倾斜；保留相机直连采集卡的无叠字原始帧/录像，不预先透视拉正、裁剪或缩放。
分别实测横向和纵向多个格子的总长度，记录测量与平整安装证据；旧记录五格95mm可作来源记录，不能证明横纵打印缩放一致。

next_camera_collection.item: 另一次采集独立验证组
next_camera_collection.details: 与拟合数据分开采集，保持同一成像设置；测重投影残差、直线度与边缘情况，记录每幅原图SHA-256、采用/拒绝理由和估计设置。不要仅用同段视频留出帧代替独立采集复验。

next_camera_collection.item: 独立清晰度与延迟素材
next_camera_collection.details: 采集清晰斜边测试图卡用于MTF50或SFR，记录曝光/图卡/分析方法/单位；随后上板用同一时间基准或同步拍摄输入与输出测端到端延迟，单独测实际新校正图率。现有100ms刺激图不能提供精确延迟验收。
